_comment: Built-in sources benchmark (voice-cli actions-bench --corpus Tests/Fixtures/sources-fr.json). The model gets every action tool, the delegation tools (Claude Code), chercher_web and the three built-in sources (meteo, cours, temps_trajet), as in the app with all of them switched on. Cases 1-13 need the weather, 14-22 a currency's or a crypto's rate, 23-31 a travel time; 32-40 need none (general knowledge, small talk), 41-47 the web search (shares and indices have no built-in source; news, scores, hours, prices of goods, strikes), 48-50 an action. expected.here: the call names no place (where the user is); when: the forecast's day ("none" for now) or the time to arrive by; instrument: what the app must find from the model's words; mode: car or transit. "here" is Cergy. "recordedSources": what the sources answered for a request, as the model reads it, recorded on 20 October 2026 with --live-sources (Open-Meteo, the ECB's rates through Frankfurter, CoinGecko, Apple's maps) and the model's own calls. Reference time: Tuesday 20 October 2026, 7:30.
